mirror_adjunction.interpretation: All listed critical-line zeros are fixed by R_adjoint. This checks the listed data only; it does not exclude unlisted off-line zeros.
mirror_adjunction.off_line_pair_rule: A hypothetical off-line zero beta+i*gamma with beta!=1/2 is mirrored to (1-beta)+i*gamma and has positive mirror defect.

Z_off_finite_audit.certification_scope: The program checks equality against a user-supplied total count; it does not authenticate the external source.
Z_off_finite_audit.certification_rule: Conditional on a valid externally supplied total count N_plus(T), Z_off_plus(T) is empty when that count equals the number of verified critical-line zeros with 0<gamma<=T.

German_function.name: G_German(T)
German_function.multiplicity_convention: N_strip(T) and N_critical_line(T) must be counted with the same multiplicity and positive-ordinate convention. A local data file contains listed ordinates, not an authenticated total strip count.
German_function.interpretation: Conditional on a valid external N_strip_plus(T), G_German_plus(T)=0 implies Z_off_plus(T)=empty for that finite T. Without that external count, the value is not computable from critical-line zeros alone.
German_function.RH_equivalence: RH is equivalent to G_German_plus(T)=0 for every finite T, using the same positive-ordinate and multiplicity conventions.

German_mirror_adjoint_function.name: G_German_star(T)
German_mirror_adjoint_function.interpretation: G_German_star(T)=0 iff every zero in the finite strip segment is fixed by the adjoint mirror, hence lies on Re(s)=1/2. It cannot be computed from listed critical-line zeros alone unless a valid external total strip enumeration/count is supplied.

Mobius_start_marker.name: M_German(T)
Mobius_start_marker.coordinate_model: Finite Mobius-marker model: write v=beta-1/2 and identify the two ends of a finite band by (0,v)~(1,-v).
Mobius_start_marker.center_line_marker_rule: On v=0, the Mobius endpoint is identified with the initial point; an oriented transverse marker returns to the same orientation only after two turns.
Mobius_start_marker.off_line_marker_rule: A point with v!=0 is sent to the opposite side under the fold. The fold pairs off-line candidates; it does not remove them.
Mobius_start_marker.closure_certification_rule: The finite path is arithmetically closed only when the independent whole-strip count equals the listed critical-line count, so G_German(T)=0.
Mobius_start_marker.interpretation: Finding the marked endpoint again is a finite closure marker. For RH, this marker must close with no off-line remainder for every finite T; a single finite closure is not a global proof.

German_bridge_lemma.name: German_prime_zero_bridge_lemma
German_bridge_lemma.display_name: Lema puente de la función Germán
German_bridge_lemma.required_input: Run with --prime-limit P to attach the prime channel.
